name: Canal for vertebral artery
d: Canal formed in some people by a bony bridge roofing the groove for the vertebral artery (ponticulus posticus).

name: External occipital crest
d: Midline ridge running from the external occipital protuberance to the foramen magnum; the nuchal ligament attaches to it.

name: Internal occipital crest
d: Midline ridge on the inner surface of the occipital bone; the falx cerebelli attaches to it.

name: Mandibular symphysis
d: Site where the two halves of the mandible fuse in the midline after birth.

name: Middle clinoid process
d: Small process at the anterolateral corner of the sella turcica; sometimes fused with the anterior clinoid.

name: Posterior obturator tubercle
d: Small prominence on the posterior margin of the obturator foramen; the obturator membrane attaches to it.

name: Supra-orbital notch
d: Notch on the upper margin of the orbit; the supraorbital nerve and artery pass through it.

name: Third trochanter
d: Extra projection seen in some people at the upper end of the gluteal tuberosity; an attachment area for gluteus maximus.

name: Vermian fossa
d: Fossa seen in some people at the lower end of the internal occipital crest; the vermis of the cerebellum lies in it.

name: Trochlear spine
d: Small spine in the trochlear fovea; holds the pulley of superior oblique.

name: Acetabular fossa
d: Non-articular floor of the acetabulum; contains fat and the ligament of the head of the femur.

name: Acetabular margin
d: Rim of the acetabulum; the acetabular labrum attaches here and deepens the socket.

name: Acetabular notch
d: Notch in the lower rim of the acetabulum; bridged by the transverse acetabular ligament, vessels pass through it.

name: Acetabulum
d: Socket of the hip bone; formed by the union of ilium, ischium and pubis, it receives the femoral head.

name: Acromial angle
d: Posterolateral corner of the acromion; a reference point for measuring arm length.

name: Acromial end
d: Flattened lateral end of the clavicle; forms the acromioclavicular joint with the acromion.

name: Acromial facet
d: Small articular facet at the lateral end; articulates with the acromion.

name: Acromion
d: Lateral end of the spine of the scapula; the highest point of the shoulder, it articulates with the clavicle.

name: Adductor tubercle
d: Small prominence above the medial epicondyle; the hamstring part of adductor magnus attaches to it.

name: Ala of ilium
d: Broad wing of the ilium; the iliac fossa lies on its inner surface and the gluteal muscles on its outer surface.

name: Ala of sacrum
d: Lateral wing of the sacrum; the lumbosacral trunk passes in front of it.

name: Anatomical neck of humerus
d: Constriction just below the articular cartilage of the humeral head; the capsule attaches here.

name: Angle of rib
d: Point where the rib curves forwards at the back; the commonest site of rib fractures.

name: Anterior arch of atlas
d: Short anterior arch of the atlas; on its inner surface is a facet that articulates with the dens.

name: Anterior articular facet of dens axis
d: Front surface of the dens; articulates with the anterior arch of the atlas.

name: Anterior border of fibula
d: Anterior border of the fibula; the septum separating the anterior and lateral compartments attaches to it.

name: Anterior border of humerus
d: Anterior border of the humerus.

name: Anterior border of radius
d: Anterior border of the radius.

name: Anterior border of tibia
d: Sharp anterior border felt under the skin (the shin).

name: Anterior border of ulna
d: Anterior border of the ulna.

name: Anterior clinoid process
d: Backward-projecting tip of the lesser wing; the tentorium cerebelli attaches to it and it lies beside the internal carotid artery.

name: Anterior gluteal line
d: Anterior line on the outer surface of the ilium; separates the origins of gluteus medius and minimus.

name: Anterior inferior iliac spine
d: Projection below the ASIS; the straight head of rectus femoris and the iliofemoral ligament attach to it.

name: Anterior intercondylar area
d: Anterior area between the condyles; the anterior cruciate ligament and the anterior horns of the menisci attach to it.

name: Anterior limb of stapes
d: Anterior limb of the stapes.

name: Anterior obturator tubercle
d: Prominence on the anterior margin of the obturator foramen.

name: Anterior process of calcaneus
d: Front end of the calcaneus; articulates with the cuboid and can fracture in ankle sprains.

name: Anterior process of malleus
d: Thin process projecting forwards from the neck of the malleus.

name: Anterior sacral foramina
d: Anterior sacral foramina; the anterior rami of the sacral nerves emerge through them.

name: Anterior superior iliac spine
d: Front end of the iliac crest; the inguinal ligament, sartorius and TFL attach to it and it is easily felt.

name: Anterior surface of petrous part
d: Surface of the petrous part facing the middle cranial fossa; bears the trigeminal impression and the arcuate eminence.

name: Anterior surface of radius
d: Anterior surface of the radius; FPL and pronator quadratus arise here.

name: Anterior tubercle of atlas
d: Prominence on the front of the anterior arch; longus colli and the anterior longitudinal ligament attach to it.

name: Anterior tubercle of transverse process
d: Anterior prominence of a cervical transverse process; at C6 the carotid tubercle (Chassaignac) can be felt.

name: Anterolateral surface of humerus
d: Anterolateral surface of the humerus; the deltoid tuberosity lies here.

name: Anteromedial surface of fibula
d: Anteromedial surface of the fibula; the anterior compartment muscles arise here.

name: Anteromedial surface of humerus
d: Anteromedial surface of the humerus; coracobrachialis and brachialis attach here.

name: Apex of coccyx
d: Tip of the coccyx; the external anal sphincter and anococcygeal ligament attach to it.

name: Apex of dens axis
d: Tip of the dens; the apical ligament runs from here to the anterior margin of the foramen magnum.

name: Apex of head of fibula
d: Tip of the fibular head; the lateral collateral ligament and biceps femoris tendon attach near it.

name: Apex of petrous part
d: Medial tip of the petrous part; bounds the foramen lacerum and lies near the trigeminal ganglion.

name: Apex of sacrum
d: Lower end of the sacrum; articulates with the coccyx.

name: Arcuate eminence
d: Bulge produced by the anterior semicircular canal.

name: Arcuate line of ilium
d: Curved line on the inner surface of the ilium; part of the boundary of the pelvic inlet.

name: Articular circumference of head of radius
d: Rim of the radial head; it rotates within the radial notch of the ulna and the annular ligament.

name: Articular circumference of head of ulna
d: Surface of the ulnar head that articulates with the ulnar notch of the radius.

name: Articular facet for malleus
d: Surface of the body of the incus that articulates with the head of the malleus.

name: Articular facet for stapes
d: Surface of the lenticular process of the incus that articulates with the head of the stapes.

name: Articular facet of head of fibula
d: Articular surface of the fibular head; forms the proximal tibiofibular joint with the tibia.

name: Articular facet of head of malleus
tr: Articular facet of head of malleus
d: Surface of the head of the malleus that articulates with the incus.

name: Articular facet of head of radius
d: Upper concavity of the radial head; articulates with the capitulum of the humerus.

name: Articular facet of head of stapes
tr: Articular facet of head of stapes
d: Surface of the head of the stapes that articulates with the incus; stapedius attaches close by.

name: Articular facet of lateral malleolus
d: Inner surface of the lateral malleolus; takes part in the ankle joint with the talus.

name: Articular facet of medial malleolus
d: Surface of the medial malleolus that articulates with the talus.

name: Articular facet of tubercle of rib
tr: Articular facet of tubercle of rib
d: Surface of the tubercle that articulates with the transverse process.

name: Articular facets of head of rib
tr: Articular facets of head of rib
d: Surfaces of the rib head that articulate with two adjacent vertebral bodies.

name: Articular surface for cuboid
d: Saddle-shaped articular surface at the front of the calcaneus; forms the calcaneocuboid joint.

name: Articular surface of medial condyle
d: Oval surface of the medial condyle that articulates with the femur.

name: Auricular surface of ilium
d: Ear-shaped articular surface; forms the sacroiliac joint with the sacrum.

name: Auricular surface of sacrum
d: Ear-shaped surface forming the sacroiliac joint with the ilium.

name: Base of coccyx
d: Upper surface of the coccyx; articulates with the apex of the sacrum.

name: Base of mandible
d: Lower border of the body of the mandible; the facial artery pulse can be felt here.

name: Base of metatarsal bone
d: Proximal end of a metatarsal; articulates with the tarsal bones and neighbouring metatarsals.

name: Base of phalanx of foot
d: Proximal end of a toe phalanx; articulates with the bone before it.
part: Proximal phalanx of third finger of foot

name: Base of phalanx of hand
d: Proximal end of a finger phalanx; articulates with the metacarpal head or the preceding phalanx.
part: Proximal phalanx of third finger of hand

name: Base of sacrum
d: Upper surface of the sacrum; articulates with L5 and bears the promontory at its front.

name: Base of stapes
d: Base of the stapes; it sits in the oval window and transmits vibration to the inner ear.

name: Basilar part of occipital bone
d: Thick part in front of the foramen magnum (clivus); the brainstem rests on it.

name: Body of clavicle
d: Body of the clavicle; S-shaped, it most often fractures in its middle third.

name: Body of femur
d: Shaft of the femur; the linea aspera runs on its posterior surface, and fractures can cause major blood loss.

name: Body of fibula
d: Thin shaft of the fibula; it does not bear weight but provides attachment for muscles.

name: Body of humerus
d: Shaft of the humerus; the radial nerve runs in the groove on its posterior surface.

name: Body of hyoid bone
d: Central body of the hyoid; the suprahyoid and infrahyoid muscles attach to it.

name: Body of ilium
d: Body of the ilium contributing to the acetabulum.

name: Body of incus
d: Body of the incus; articulates with the head of the malleus.

name: Body of ischium
d: Body of the ischium contributing to the acetabulum.

name: Body of mandible
d: Horseshoe-shaped body of the mandible; carries the lower teeth.

name: Body of metatarsal bone
d: Shaft of a metatarsal; stress fractures from walking are most common here.

name: Body of phalanx of foot
d: Shaft of a toe phalanx.
part: Proximal phalanx of third finger of foot

name: Body of phalanx of hand
d: Shaft of a finger phalanx; its front surface carries the sheath of the flexor tendons.
part: Proximal phalanx of third finger of hand

name: Body of pubis
d: Midline body of the pubis; forms the symphysis with the opposite side.

name: Body of radius
d: Shaft of the radius; it curves slightly outwards, which aids supination.

name: Body of rib
d: Thin, curved shaft of the rib.

name: Body of sphenoid bone
d: Cube-shaped body of the sphenoid; it contains the sphenoidal sinus and bears the sella turcica above.

name: Body of talus
d: Main mass of the talus; the trochlea lies on top of it.

name: Body of tibia
d: Shaft of the tibia; triangular in cross-section, its anteromedial surface lies just under the skin.

name: Body of ulna
d: Shaft of the ulna; its posterior border can be felt under the skin.

name: Calcaneal sulcus
d: Groove on the upper surface of the calcaneus; with the groove on the talus it forms the sinus tarsi.

name: Calcaneal tubercle
d: Prominence on the lower front surface of the calcaneus; the plantar ligaments attach to it.

name: Calcaneal tuberosity
d: Posterior projection of the heel; the Achilles tendon inserts here and it bears weight during standing.

name: Capitulum of humerus
d: Rounded articular surface at the lower lateral end of the humerus; forms the humeroradial joint with the radial head.

name: Carotid sulcus
d: Groove on the side of the body of the sphenoid; the internal carotid artery runs here within the cavernous sinus.

name: Carpal articular surface
d: Lower articular surface of the radius; forms the wrist joint with the scaphoid and lunate.

name: Cerebral fossa
d: Upper fossae in which the occipital lobes rest.

name: Cerebral surface of greater wing
d: Surface of the greater wing facing the middle cranial fossa; the temporal lobe rests against it.

name: Chiasmatic sulcus
d: Groove between the two optic canals; it lies next to the optic chiasm.

name: Clavicular facet
d: Small surface of the acromion that articulates with the clavicle.

name: Clavicular notch
d: Superolateral notch of the manubrium; forms the sternoclavicular joint with the clavicle.

name: Coccygeal horn
d: Processes projecting upwards from the base of the coccyx; they articulate with the sacral cornua.

name: Condylar canal
d: Canal behind the condyle; an emissary vein passes through it.

name: Condylar fossa
d: Fossa behind the occipital condyle.

name: Condyle of humerus
d: Lower end of the humerus; includes the trochlea, the capitulum and the fossae.

name: Conoid tubercle
d: Prominence on the lower surface of the lateral end; the conoid part of the coracoclavicular ligament attaches to it.

name: Coracoid process
d: Beak-like process of the scapula projecting forwards; pectoralis minor, coracobrachialis and the short head of biceps attach to it.

name: Coronoid fossa
d: Anterior fossa above the trochlea; the coronoid process of the ulna enters it when the elbow is flexed.

name: Coronoid process of ulna
d: Anterior projection of the trochlear notch; brachialis attaches to it and it can fracture in elbow dislocation.

name: Costal groove
d: Groove on the inner surface of the lower border of the rib; the intercostal vein, artery and nerve run in it.

name: Costal notches
d: Notches on the borders of the sternum; the costal cartilages articulate with the sternum here.

name: Costal part of transverse process
d: Part of a lumbar transverse process that is a remnant of a rib.

name: Crest of greater tubercle
d: Ridge descending from the greater tubercle; pectoralis major attaches to it.

name: Crest of head of rib
d: Ridge separating the two articular facets of the rib head; the intra-articular ligament attaches to it.

name: Crest of lesser tubercle
d: Ridge descending from the lesser tubercle; teres major attaches to it.

name: Crest of neck of rib
d: Upper border of the neck of the rib; the superior costotransverse ligament attaches to it.

name: Crown of tooth
d: Part of the tooth covered by enamel and visible in the mouth.

name: Cruciform eminence
d: Cross-shaped elevation on the inner surface; the grooves of the dural sinuses meet here.

name: Cusp of tooth
d: Cusps on the chewing surface of the premolars and molars.

name: Deltoid tubercle
d: Prominence on the spine of the scapula; deltoid and trapezius attach to it.

name: Deltoid tuberosity
d: Rough area on the lateral surface of the humeral shaft; deltoid inserts here.

name: Dens axis
d: Tooth-like process projecting up from the axis; the atlas rotates around it, producing the 'no' movement of the head.

name: Digastric fossa
d: Fossa on the inner lower surface of the mandible; the anterior belly of digastric attaches here.

name: Distal surface of tooth
d: Surface of a tooth facing the back of the dental arch.

name: Dorsal radial tubercle
d: Lister's tubercle; the EPL tendon turns around it on its way to the thumb.

name: Dorsal surface of sacrum
d: Convex posterior surface of the sacrum; the deep back muscles attach to it.

name: Dorsum sellae
d: Posterior wall of the sella turcica.

name: Ethmoidal notch
d: Gap between the orbital plates of the frontal bone; the cribriform plate of the ethmoid fits into it.

name: External occipital protuberance
d: Prominence felt in the middle of the back of the head (inion); trapezius and the nuchal ligament attach to it.

name: External surface of squamous part of frontal bone
d: Bony surface of the forehead; the frontal sinus lies beneath it.

name: External surface of parietal bone
d: Outer surface of the parietal bone; the temporal lines lie on it.

name: Facet for calcaneonavicular part of bifurcate ligament
tr: Facet for calcaneonavicular part of bifurcate ligament
la: Facies articularis partis calcaneonavicularis ligamenti bifurcati
d: Articular surface on the head of the talus that the bifurcate ligament touches.

name: Facet for dens
d: Articular surface on the back of the anterior arch of the atlas; forms the median atlanto-axial joint with the dens.

name: Facet for plantar calcaneonavicular ligament
d: Articular surface of the head of the talus that rests on the spring (plantar calcaneonavicular) ligament.

name: Fibular articular facet
d: Surface of the lateral condyle that articulates with the head of the fibula.

name: Fibular notch
d: Notch at the lower end of the tibia; forms a syndesmosis with the fibula.

name: Foramen caecum of frontal bone
d: Small hole in front of the frontal crest; an emissary vein from the nose to the superior sagittal sinus may pass through it.

name: Foramen magnum
d: Large opening in the skull base; the medulla, the vertebral arteries and the spinal roots of the accessory nerve (XI) pass through it.

name: Foramen ovale
d: Oval hole in the greater wing; the mandibular nerve (V3) passes through it.

name: Foramen rotundum
d: Round hole in the greater wing; the maxillary nerve (V2) passes through it.

name: Foramen spinosum
d: Small hole in the greater wing; the middle meningeal artery passes through it.

name: Foramen transversarium
d: Hole in the cervical transverse processes; the vertebral artery passes through it from C6 to C1.

name: Fossa for lacrimal gland
d: Fossa in the anterolateral part of the orbital roof; the orbital part of the lacrimal gland lies in it.

name: Fovea for ligament of head of femur
d: Pit on the femoral head; the ligament of the head of the femur and the small artery within it enter here.

name: Frontal angle of parietal bone
d: Anterosuperior angle facing the bregma.

name: Frontal border of parietal bone
d: Border forming the coronal suture with the frontal bone.

name: Frontal crest
d: Midline ridge on the inner surface of the frontal bone; the falx cerebri attaches to it.

name: Frontal eminence
d: Prominence on each side of the forehead; the site of the ossification centre at birth.

name: Frontal margin of greater wing
d: Margin that articulates with the frontal bone.

name: Genion
d: Tip of the mental spines; an anthropometric landmark.

name: Glabella
d: Smooth area between the eyebrows; a reference point in anthropometric measurement.

name: Glenoid fossa
d: Shallow fossa forming the shoulder joint with the humeral head; deepened by the labrum.

name: Glenoid process of scapula
d: Lateral angle carrying the glenoid cavity.

name: Gluteal surface of ilium
d: Outer surface of the ilium; the gluteal muscles arise here.

name: Gluteal tuberosity
d: Rough area on the upper posterior surface of the femur; the deep fibres of gluteus maximus attach here.

name: Gnathion
d: Lowest anterior point of the chin; an anthropometric landmark.

name: Greater horn of hyoid bone
d: Large horn projecting backwards from the body; felt on both sides when examining the throat.

name: Greater sciatic foramen
d: Greater sciatic foramen; piriformis, the sciatic nerve and the gluteal vessels and nerves pass through it.

name: Greater sciatic notch
d: Large notch on the posterior border of the ilium; ligaments convert it into the greater sciatic foramen.

name: Greater trochanter
d: Large projection at the upper lateral end of the femoral neck; gluteus medius, minimus and piriformis attach to it, and it is felt on the side of the hip.

name: Greater tubercle
d: Large prominence on the lateral side of the humeral head; supraspinatus, infraspinatus and teres minor attach to it.

name: Greater wing
d: Large wing of the sphenoid extending laterally; forms part of the middle cranial fossa and the lateral wall of the orbit.

name: Groove for marginal sinus
d: Groove for the marginal sinus around the foramen magnum.

name: Groove for middle meningeal artery
d: Branching groove on the inner surface; the middle meningeal artery runs in it, and fractures here cause an extradural haematoma.

name: Groove for occipital sinus
d: Groove for the occipital sinus along the internal occipital crest.

name: Groove for spinal nerve
d: Groove on the upper surface of a cervical transverse process; the spinal nerve runs in it.

name: Groove for subclavius muscle
d: Groove on the lower surface of the shaft; subclavius attaches here.

name: Groove for tendon of flexor hallucis longus of calcaneus
tr: Groove for flexor hallucis longus tendon (calcaneus)
la: Sulcus tendinis flexoris longi hallucis calcanei
d: Groove beneath the sustentaculum tali; the flexor hallucis longus tendon passes here.

name: Groove for transverse sinus
d: Horizontal groove on the inner surface; the transverse sinus runs in it and the tentorium cerebelli attaches to it.

name: Groove for ulnar nerve
d: Groove behind the medial epicondyle; the ulnar nerve runs superficially here ('funny bone').

name: Groove for vertebral artery
d: Groove on the upper surface of the posterior arch; the vertebral artery and the suboccipital nerve (C1) run here.

name: Groove of pterygoid hamulus
d: Groove of the pterygoid hamulus; the tensor veli palatini tendon turns around it.

name: Grooves for extensor tendons
d: Grooves on the lower posterior surface of the radius; the extensor tendons pass through them.

name: Handle of malleus
d: Handle of the malleus; embedded in the eardrum, its tip forms the umbo. Tensor tympani attaches here.

name: Head of femur
d: Rounded articular head of the femur; forms the hip joint with the acetabulum, and its blood supply comes from the medial circumflex femoral artery.

name: Head of fibula
d: Upper end of the fibula; the common fibular nerve winds around it behind and laterally.

name: Head of humerus
d: Hemispherical articular head; forms the shoulder joint with the glenoid cavity.

name: Head of malleus
d: Head of the malleus in the upper middle ear; articulates with the incus.

name: Head of metatarsal bone
d: Distal head of a metatarsal; bears weight in the sole and articulates with the proximal phalanx.

name: Head of radius
d: Disc-shaped upper end of the radius; it rotates at the elbow and in children can slip out of the annular ligament.

name: Head of rib
d: Head of the rib that articulates with the vertebral column.

name: Head of talus
d: Head articulating with the navicular; the keystone of the medial arch.

name: Head of ulna
d: Head at the lower end of the ulna; felt on the posteromedial side of the wrist.

name: Hook of hamate bone
d: Hook of the hamate projecting towards the palm; forms the lateral wall of Guyon's canal and can fracture in golfers.

name: Hypoglossal canal
d: Canal above the condyle; the hypoglossal nerve leaves the skull through it.

name: Hypophysial fossa
d: Fossa in the sella turcica; the pituitary gland lies in it.

name: Iliac crest
d: Upper border of the ilium; the abdominal and back muscles attach to it, and bone marrow aspiration can be performed here.

name: Iliac fossa
d: Broad fossa on the inner surface of the ilium; iliacus arises here.

name: Iliac tubercle
d: Prominence on the outer lip of the iliac crest, about 5 cm behind the ASIS.

name: Iliac tuberosity
d: Rough area above the auricular surface; the strong sacroiliac ligaments attach to it.

name: Iliopubic eminence
d: Prominence where the ilium and pubis meet.

name: Ilium
d: The largest, upper part of the hip bone.

name: Impression for costoclavicular ligament
d: Rough area on the lower surface of the medial end; the costoclavicular ligament to the 1st rib attaches here.

name: Inferior angle of scapula
d: Lower tip of the scapula; at the level of T7.

name: Inferior articular surface of atlas
d: Lower surface of the lateral mass; forms the lateral atlanto-axial joint with the axis.

name: Inferior articular surface of tibia
d: Lower surface forming the ankle joint with the talus.

name: Inferior costal facet
d: Half facet on the lower border of a thoracic vertebral body; articulates with the head of the rib below.

name: Inferior gluteal line
d: Lower line on the outer surface of the ilium; bounds the origin of gluteus minimus.

name: Inferior mental spine
d: Lower spine on the inner surface; geniohyoid attaches to it.

name: Inferior nuchal line
d: Lower line where neck muscles attach; the suboccipital muscles attach to it.

name: Inferior pubic ramus
d: Lower ramus of the pubis; it joins the ischial ramus to form the ischiopubic ramus.

name: Infraglenoid tubercle
d: Prominence below the glenoid; the long head of triceps arises here.

name: Infraspinous fossa
d: Fossa below the spine; infraspinatus arises here.

name: Infratemporal surface of greater wing
d: Surface of the greater wing facing the infratemporal fossa; the upper head of lateral pterygoid arises here.

name: Inner lip of iliac crest
d: Inner lip of the iliac crest; transversus abdominis and quadratus lumborum attach to it.

name: Intercondylar area
d: Area between the two condyles on the tibial plateau.

name: Intercondylar eminence
d: Prominence between the condyles; the cruciate ligaments attach around it.

name: Intercondylar fossa
d: Deep notch between the two condyles; the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments attach here.

name: Intercondylar line
d: Line separating the intercondylar fossa from the popliteal surface; the joint capsule attaches to it.

name: Intermediate sacral crest
d: Ridge formed by the fused articular processes.

name: Intermediate zone
d: Line between the inner and outer lips of the iliac crest; internal oblique attaches to it.

name: Internal surface of parietal bone
d: Inner surface facing the brain.

name: Internal surface of squamous part of frontal bone
d: Surface of the frontal bone facing the brain; it carries the frontal lobe.

name: Interosseous border of radius
d: Sharp border facing the ulna; the interosseous membrane attaches to it.

name: Interosseous border of tibia
d: Border facing the fibula; the interosseous membrane attaches to it.

name: Interosseous border of ulna
d: Sharp border facing the radius; the interosseous membrane attaches to it.

name: Interosseous crest of fibula
d: Border of the fibula facing the tibia; the interosseous membrane attaches to it.

name: Intertrochanteric crest
d: Ridge joining the trochanters behind; the quadrate tubercle lies on it.

name: Intertrochanteric line
d: Line joining the trochanters in front; the hip joint capsule and iliofemoral ligament attach to it.

name: Intervertebral foramina
d: Openings connecting the sacral canal to the anterior and posterior sacral foramina.

name: Intrajugular process of occipital bone
d: Small process that partly divides the jugular foramen.

name: Ischial spine
d: Spine on the posterior border of the ischium; the sacrospinous ligament attaches to it, and it guides pudendal nerve block.

name: Ischial tuberosity
d: Tuberosity that bears weight when sitting; the hamstrings and the sacrotuberous ligament attach to it.

name: Ischiopubic ramus
d: Union of the ischial and pubic rami; bounds the obturator foramen below, and the crura of the penis/clitoris attach to it.

name: Ischium
d: Posteroinferior part of the hip bone (the sitting bone).

name: Jugular notch of occipital bone
d: Notch that forms the jugular foramen together with the temporal bone.

name: Jugular process
d: Process behind the jugular notch; rectus capitis lateralis attaches to it.

name: Lateral angle of scapula
d: Lateral angle of the scapula carrying the glenoid.

name: Lateral border of humerus
d: Lateral border of the humerus; below it continues as the lateral supracondylar ridge.

name: Lateral border of scapula
d: Lateral border facing the axilla; teres major and minor arise from it.

name: Lateral condyle of femur
d: Lateral condyle of the femur; forms the knee joint with the tibia and meniscus, and its forward prominence prevents lateral slipping of the patella.

name: Lateral condyle of tibia
d: Lateral condyle of the tibia; the lateral meniscus rests on it.

name: Lateral epicondyle of femur
d: Prominence on the lateral condyle; the lateral collateral ligament and the lateral head of gastrocnemius attach to it.

name: Lateral epicondyle of humerus
d: Lateral epicondyle of the humerus; common origin of the forearm extensors (tennis elbow).

name: Lateral intercondylar tubercle
d: Lateral tubercle of the intercondylar eminence.

name: Lateral lip of linea aspera
d: Lateral lip of the linea aspera; vastus lateralis and the short head of biceps femoris attach to it.

name: Lateral malleolar facet
d: Triangular surface that articulates with the lateral malleolus.

name: Lateral malleolus
d: Lower end of the fibula; it reaches further down and further back than the medial malleolus.

name: Lateral mass
d: Thick lateral part of the atlas on each side; transfers weight from the skull to the axis.

name: Lateral process of calcaneal tuberosity
d: Lateral process of the calcaneal tuberosity; abductor digiti minimi arises here.

name: Lateral process of malleus
d: Small process of the malleus that makes a bulge on the eardrum.

name: Lateral process of talus
d: Lateral process of the talus; site of the snowboarder's fracture.

name: Lateral pterygoid plate
d: Lateral plate of the pterygoid process; both pterygoid muscles arise from it.

name: Lateral sacral crest
d: Ridge formed by the fused transverse processes; the sacrotuberous ligament attaches to it.

name: Lateral supracondylar line
d: Continuation of the linea aspera down to the lateral condyle; plantaris and the lateral head of gastrocnemius arise from it.

name: Lateral supracondylar ridge
d: Ridge above the lateral epicondyle; brachioradialis and ECRL arise from it.

name: Lateral surface of fibula
d: Lateral surface of the fibula; fibularis longus and brevis arise from it.

name: Lateral surface of radius
d: Lateral surface of the radius; pronator teres inserts at its middle.

name: Lateral surface of tibia
d: Lateral surface of the tibia; tibialis anterior arises from it.

name: Lateral tubercle
d: Lateral tubercle of the posterior process of the talus; the posterior talofibular ligament attaches to it.

name: Lenticular process of incus
d: Lens-shaped process at the tip of the long limb; articulates with the stapes.

name: Lesser horn of hyoid bone
d: Lesser horn; the stylohyoid ligament attaches to it.

name: Lesser sciatic foramen
d: Lesser sciatic foramen; the obturator internus tendon, the pudendal nerve and the internal pudendal vessels pass through it.

name: Lesser sciatic notch
d: Notch below the ischial spine; ligaments convert it into the lesser sciatic foramen.

name: Lesser trochanter
d: Projection on the posteromedial side of the femoral neck; iliopsoas inserts here.

name: Lesser tubercle
d: Small prominence on the front of the humerus; subscapularis inserts here.

name: Lesser wing
d: Small wing surrounding the optic canal; forms the posterior border of the anterior cranial fossa.

name: Limbus of sphenoid
d: Posterior edge of the jugum of the sphenoid.

name: Linea aspera
d: Rough line on the back of the femoral shaft; the adductors and the vasti attach to it.

name: Lingual surface of tooth
d: Surface of a tooth facing the tongue.

name: Long limb of incus
d: Long limb of the incus extending downwards; it runs parallel to the handle of the malleus.

name: Lunate surface
d: Crescent-shaped articular surface of the acetabulum; the cartilage-covered part in contact with the femoral head.

name: Malleolar fossa
d: Fossa on the posteromedial surface of the lateral malleolus; the posterior talofibular ligament attaches to it.

name: Mastoid angle of parietal bone
d: Posteroinferior angle facing the mastoid region.

name: Mastoid notch
d: Notch on the medial side of the mastoid process; the posterior belly of digastric arises here.

name: Mastoid process
d: Projection felt behind the ear; it is filled with air cells and SCM attaches to it.

name: Maxillary dental arch
d: Upper dental arch; it carries 16 permanent teeth.

name: Maxillary surface of greater wing
d: Surface of the greater wing facing the pterygopalatine fossa; the foramen rotundum opens here.

name: Medial border of fibula
d: Medial border of the fibula.

name: Medial condyle of femur
d: Medial condyle of the femur; it is longer and reaches lower than the lateral condyle, producing the carrying angle.

name: Medial condyle of tibia
d: Medial condyle of the tibia; semimembranosus attaches to its back.

name: Medial epicondyle of femur
d: Prominence on the medial condyle; the medial collateral ligament attaches to it.

name: Medial epicondyle of humerus
d: Medial epicondyle of the humerus; common origin of the forearm flexors, with the ulnar nerve passing behind it.

name: Medial intercondylar tubercle
d: Medial tubercle of the intercondylar eminence.

name: Medial lip of linea aspera
d: Medial lip of the linea aspera; vastus medialis and the adductors attach to it.

name: Medial malleolar facet
d: Comma-shaped surface that articulates with the medial malleolus.

name: Medial malleolus
d: Lower end of the tibia felt under the skin; the great saphenous vein passes in front of it (emergency venous access).

name: Medial process of calcaneal tuberosity
d: Medial process of the calcaneal tuberosity; abductor hallucis and the plantar aponeurosis arise here.

name: Medial pterygoid plate
d: Medial plate of the pterygoid process; the pterygoid hamulus lies at its tip.

name: Medial supracondylar line
d: Continuation of the linea aspera down to the medial condyle; it ends at the adductor tubercle.

name: Medial supracondylar ridge
d: Ridge above the medial epicondyle.

name: Medial surface of fibula
d: Medial surface of the fibula; the extensor muscles of the anterior compartment arise from it.

name: Medial surface of tibia
d: Broad anteromedial surface just under the skin; bone grafts and intraosseous access can be taken here.

name: Medial surface of ulna
d: Medial surface of the ulna; FDP arises from it.

name: Medial tubercle
d: Medial tubercle of the posterior process; the deltoid ligament attaches to it.

name: Median sacral crest
d: Midline ridge formed by the fused spinous processes.

name: Mental foramen
d: Foramen below the second premolar; the mental nerve and artery emerge from it.

name: Mental protuberance
d: The prominence of the chin.

name: Mental tubercle
d: Prominence on each side of the mental protuberance.

name: Mesial surface of tooth
d: Surface of a tooth facing the front (midline) of the dental arch.

name: Mylohyoid line
d: Oblique line on the inner surface of the mandible; mylohyoid, which forms the floor of the mouth, attaches to it.

name: Nasal spine of frontal bone
d: Small spine supporting the nasal septum.

name: Neck of femur
d: Neck joining the head to the shaft; it often fractures in the elderly and can lead to avascular necrosis of the head.

name: Neck of fibula
d: Neck below the head; the common fibular nerve lies against the bone here, and a fracture can cause foot drop.

name: Neck of malleus
d: Constriction between the head and handle of the malleus.

name: Neck of radius
d: Constriction between the head and the tuberosity.

name: Neck of rib
d: Part between the head and the tubercle.

name: Neck of scapula
d: Constriction just medial to the glenoid.

name: Neck of talus
d: Constriction between the head and the body; after a fracture here avascular necrosis of the body is common.

name: Neck of tooth
d: Constriction where the crown meets the root; the gum ends here.

name: Oblique line of mandible
d: Oblique line on the outer surface; muscles of the corner of the mouth attach to it.

name: Obturator crest
d: Ridge on the superior pubic ramus; the pubofemoral ligament attaches to it.

name: Obturator foramen
d: Large opening surrounded by the pubis and ischium; closed by the obturator membrane, with the obturator vessels and nerve passing through the canal at its top.

name: Occipital angle of parietal bone
d: Posterosuperior angle facing the lambda.

name: Occipital condyle
d: Articular projection on each side of the foramen magnum; forms with the atlas the joint that produces the 'yes' movement.

name: Occipital plane
d: Smooth area above the superior nuchal line.

name: Occlusal surface of tooth
d: Chewing surface that meets the opposing tooth.

name: Olecranon fossa
d: Deep fossa on the lower posterior surface of the humerus; the olecranon enters it when the elbow is extended.

name: Olecranon
d: Projection forming the point of the elbow; triceps inserts into it.

name: Opening of frontal sinus
d: Opening of the frontal sinus; it drains through the frontonasal duct into the middle meatus.

name: Optic canal
d: Canal in the lesser wing; the optic nerve and ophthalmic artery pass through it.

name: Orbital plate of frontal bone
d: Thin bony plate forming the roof of the orbit; it is the floor of the anterior cranial fossa.

name: Orbital surface of frontal bone
d: Surface of the orbital roof facing the eye.

name: Orbital surface of greater wing
d: Surface forming the lateral wall of the orbit.

name: Parietal eminence
d: The most prominent point of the parietal bone; the ossification centre.

name: Parietal foramen
d: Small hole near the sagittal border; an emissary vein passes through it.

name: Patellar surface of femur
d: Articular surface in front of the condyles; forms the patellofemoral joint with the patella.

name: Pectineal line of femur
d: Line running from the lesser trochanter to the linea aspera; pectineus inserts here.

name: Pharyngeal tubercle
d: Prominence on the lower surface of the basilar part; the fibrous raphe of the pharynx attaches to it.

name: Popliteal surface of femur
d: Flat lower posterior surface of the femur; it forms the floor of the popliteal fossa and lies next to the popliteal artery.

name: Posterior arch of atlas
d: Long posterior arch of the atlas; it carries a posterior tubercle instead of a spinous process.

name: Posterior clinoid process
d: Upper corners of the dorsum sellae; the tentorium attaches to them.

name: Posterior gluteal line
d: Posterior line on the outer surface of the ilium; bounds the origin of gluteus maximus.

name: Posterior inferior iliac spine
d: Projection at the posteroinferior end of the auricular surface.

name: Posterior intercondylar area
d: Posterior area between the condyles; the posterior cruciate ligament attaches here.

name: Posterior limb of stapes
d: Posterior limb of the stapes.

name: Posterior malleolus
d: Posterior margin of the lower end of the tibia; it breaks in trimalleolar fractures.

name: Posterior sacral foramina
d: Posterior sacral foramina; the posterior rami of the sacral nerves emerge through them.

name: Posterior superior iliac spine
d: Posterior end of the iliac crest; the dimple in the skin over it (dimple of Venus) marks the S2 level.

name: Posterior surface of fibula
d: Posterior surface of the fibula; soleus and FHL arise from it.

name: Posterior surface of petrous part
d: Surface facing the posterior cranial fossa; the internal acoustic meatus opens on it.

name: Posterior surface of scapula
d: Posterior surface divided in two by the spine of the scapula.

name: Posterior tubercle of atlas
d: Prominence in the middle of the posterior arch; rectus capitis posterior minor and the nuchal ligament attach to it.

name: Posterior tubercle of transverse process
d: Posterior prominence of a cervical transverse process; the scalene muscles attach to it.

name: Pronator tuberosity
d: Rough area on the lateral surface of the radius; pronator teres inserts here.

name: Pterygoid canal
d: Canal at the root of the pterygoid process; the nerve of the pterygoid canal (Vidian nerve) passes through it.

name: Pterygoid fossa
d: Fossa between the two pterygoid plates; medial pterygoid arises here.

name: Pterygoid hamulus
d: Hook at the tip of the medial plate; the tensor veli palatini tendon turns around it.

name: Pterygoid notch
d: Notch at the lower end of the two plates; a process of the palatine bone fits into it.

name: Pubic crest
d: Upper border of the body of the pubis; rectus abdominis and pyramidalis attach to it.

name: Pubic tubercle
d: Prominence at the lateral end of the pubic crest; the inguinal ligament attaches to it, and it is a landmark in hernia examination.

name: Quadrate tubercle
d: Prominence on the intertrochanteric crest; quadratus femoris inserts here.

name: Radial fossa
d: Small anterior fossa above the capitulum; the radial head enters it when the elbow is flexed.

name: Radial notch
d: Notch on the lateral side of the coronoid process; forms the proximal radio-ulnar joint with the radial head.

name: Outer lip of iliac crest
d: Outer lip of the iliac crest; external oblique, TFL and the fascia lata attach to it.

name: Root apex
d: Tip of the root; nerves and vessels enter the tooth through the apical foramen.

name: Sacral canal
d: Continuation of the vertebral canal in the sacrum; it contains the lower roots of the cauda equina and the filum terminale.

name: Sacral hiatus
d: Opening at the lower posterior end of the sacrum; caudal epidural anaesthesia is given here.

name: Sacral horn
d: Horns on each side of the hiatus; they guide caudal block.

name: Scaphoid fossa
d: Fossa above the medial plate; tensor veli palatini arises here.

name: Scapular notch
d: Notch on the upper border; the suprascapular nerve passes beneath it and the suprascapular artery above.

name: Soleal line
d: Oblique line on the posterior surface; soleus arises from it.

name: Sphenoidal angle of parietal bone
d: Anteroinferior angle contributing to the pterion; the anterior branch of the middle meningeal artery runs on its inner surface.

name: Sphenoidal crest
d: Midline ridge on the front of the body; it contributes to the nasal septum.

name: Sphenoidal lingula
d: Tongue-shaped projection on the lateral edge of the carotid sulcus.

name: Sphenoidal yoke
d: Flat bony area joining the two lesser wings (jugum).

name: Frontal part of orbital margin
d: Part of the frontal bone forming the upper margin of the orbit.

name: Groove for popliteus muscle
d: Groove on the outer surface of the lateral condyle; the popliteus tendon lies here.

name: Intertubercular sulcus
d: Groove between the two tubercles; the tendon of the long head of biceps runs in it.

name: Lateral part of occipital bone
d: Part beside the foramen magnum; carries the condyles.

name: Lateral part of sacrum
d: Lateral parts of the sacrum; they carry the alae and the auricular surfaces.

name: Malleolar groove of fibula
d: Groove behind the lateral malleolus; the tendons of the fibular muscles pass through it.

name: Malleolar groove of tibia
d: Groove behind the medial malleolus; the tibialis posterior and FDL tendons pass through it.

name: Mastoid border of occipital bone
d: Border that articulates with the mastoid part of the temporal bone.

name: Medial border of humerus
d: Medial border of the humerus.

name: Medial border of scapula
d: Medial border facing the spine; the rhomboids and serratus anterior attach to it.

name: Middle facet for calcaneus
d: Middle surface that articulates with the sustentaculum tali.

name: Nasal margin of frontal bone
d: Margin that articulates with the nasal bones.

name: Nasal part of frontal bone
d: Part of the frontal bone extending to the root of the nose.

name: Navicular articular surface
d: Surface of the head of the talus that articulates with the navicular.

name: Obturator groove
d: Groove on the lower surface of the superior pubic ramus; forms the roof of the obturator canal.

name: Occipital border of parietal bone
d: Border forming the lambdoid suture with the occipital bone.

name: Occipital margin of temporal bone
d: Margin that articulates with the occipital bone.

name: Parietal margin of frontal bone
d: Margin forming the coronal suture with the parietal bones.

name: Parietal margin of greater wing
d: Tip that articulates with the parietal bone; it contributes to the pterion.

name: Pecten pubis
d: Sharp edge on the superior pubic ramus; pectineus and the pectineal ligament attach to it.

name: Pelvic surface of sacrum
d: Concave anterior surface of the sacrum facing the pelvis; piriformis arises here.

name: Petrous part of temporal bone
d: Hard pyramidal part housing the inner and middle ear.

name: Posterior articular facet of dens axis
d: Back of the dens; articulates with the transverse ligament of the atlas.

name: Posterior border of fibula
d: Posterior border of the fibula.

name: Posterior border of radius
d: Posterior border of the radius.

name: Posterior border of ulna
d: Posterior border felt under the skin.

name: Posterior calcaneal articular facet
d: Large posterior surface forming the subtalar joint with the calcaneus.

name: Posterior process of talus
d: Posterior process; the FHL tendon passes in the groove between its two tubercles.

name: Posterior surface of humerus
d: Posterior surface of the humerus; it carries the triceps heads and the radial groove.

name: Posterior surface of radius
d: Posterior surface of the radius; APL and EPB arise from it.

name: Posterior surface of tibia
d: Posterior surface of the tibia; it carries the soleal line.

name: Posterior surface of ulna
d: Posterior surface of the ulna; the deep extensors arise from it.

name: Posteromedial surface of fibula
d: Posteromedial surface of the fibula; tibialis posterior arises from it.

name: Promontory
d: Anterosuperior edge of the sacrum; the posterior boundary of the pelvic inlet and a reference point in obstetric measurement.

name: Pterygoid process
d: Process extending downwards from the sphenoid; it consists of two plates.

name: Pterygospinous process
d: Process on the posterior border of the lateral plate; a ligament joins it to the spine of the sphenoid.

name: Pubis
d: Anteroinferior part of the hip bone.

name: Radial groove
d: Spiral groove on the back of the humeral shaft; the radial nerve and profunda brachii artery run in it.

name: Radial styloid process
d: Process at the lower lateral end of the radius; brachioradialis inserts into it, and it lies lower than the ulnar styloid.

name: Radial tuberosity
d: Prominence below the neck; the biceps brachii tendon inserts here.

name: Ramus of ischium
d: Forward-extending ramus of the ischium.

name: Root of tooth
d: Part of the tooth embedded in the alveolus; covered with cementum.

name: Sacral tuberosity
d: Rough area behind the auricular surface; the interosseous sacroiliac ligaments attach to it.

name: Sacropelvic surface of ilium
d: Inner posterior surface of the ilium facing the sacrum and pelvis.

name: Sagittal border of parietal bone
d: Border forming the sagittal suture with the opposite parietal.

name: Sella turcica
d: Saddle-shaped structure on the upper surface of the body; contains the hypophysial fossa.

name: Septum of frontal sinuses
d: Thin bony septum separating the two frontal sinuses; it usually deviates from the midline.

name: Septum of sphenoidal sinuses
d: Septum separating the two sphenoidal sinuses; a guide in transsphenoidal surgery.

name: Sphenoidal margin of frontal bone
d: Margin that articulates with the sphenoid.

name: Spine of scapula
d: Bony ridge dividing the posterior surface in two; trapezius and deltoid attach to it.

name: Spine of sphenoid bone
d: Spine at the posterior end of the greater wing; the sphenomandibular ligament attaches to it.

name: Spinoglenoid notch
d: Notch between the spine and the glenoid; the suprascapular nerve passes through it to the infraspinous fossa.

name: Squamosal border of parietal bone
d: Border that articulates with the squamous part of the temporal bone.

name: Squamosal margin of greater wing
d: Margin that articulates with the squamous part of the temporal bone.

name: Squamous part of frontal bone
d: Broad squamous part forming the forehead.

name: Squamous part of occipital bone
d: Broad posterior squamous part of the occipital bone.

name: Squamous part of temporal bone
d: Thin squamous part forming the temple; a fracture here can cause an extradural haematoma.

name: Sternal angle
d: Angle where the manubrium meets the body; at the level of the 2nd rib, it is used for counting ribs.

name: Sternal articular surface
d: Articular surface at the medial end; forms the sternoclavicular joint with the sternum and the articular disc.

name: Sternal end
d: Thick medial end of the clavicle; forms the only joint attaching the upper limb to the trunk.

name: Styloid process of temporal bone
d: Thin process projecting downwards below the ear; three 'stylo-' muscles and two ligaments attach to it.

name: Styloid process of third metacarpal bone
d: Small process on the base of the 3rd metacarpal; the ECRB tendon attaches near it.

name: Sublime tubercle
d: Prominence on the medial side of the coronoid process; the anterior band of the ulnar collateral ligament attaches to it.

name: Sublingual fossa
d: Fossa on the inner surface above the mylohyoid line; the sublingual gland lies in it.

name: Subscapular fossa
d: Anterior surface facing the chest wall; subscapularis arises here.

name: Sulcus of auditory tube
d: Groove in which the cartilaginous part of the auditory (Eustachian) tube lies.

name: Superior angle of scapula
d: Superomedial angle of the scapula; levator scapulae attaches to it.

name: Superior articular process of sacrum
d: Process forming a facet joint with L5.

name: Superior articular surface of atlas
d: Concavity on the upper surface of the lateral mass; with the occipital condyles it forms the joint for the 'yes' movement.

name: Superior articular surface of lateral condyle
tr: Superior articular surface of lateral condyle
d: Surface of the lateral condyle that articulates with the femur.

name: Superior articular surfaces of tibia
d: Surfaces of the tibial plateau that articulate with the femoral condyles.

name: Superior border of scapula
d: Short upper border of the scapula; the inferior belly of omohyoid arises here.

name: Superior costal facet
d: Half facet on the upper border of the body; articulates with the head of the rib of the same number.

name: Superior facet of talus
tr: Superior facet of trochlea of talus
d: Upper articular surface of the trochlea facing the tibia.

name: Superior mental spine
d: Upper spine on the inner surface; genioglossus attaches to it.

name: Superior nuchal line
d: Superior nuchal line; trapezius, SCM and splenius capitis attach to it.

name: Superior pubic ramus
d: Upper ramus of the pubis; the femoral vessels pass in front of it into the thigh.

name: Superior temporal line
d: Upper line to which the temporal fascia attaches.

name: Supinator crest
d: Ridge below the radial notch; supinator arises from it.

name: Supra-acetabular groove
d: Groove on the upper rim of the acetabulum; the reflected head of rectus femoris attaches to it.

name: Supraglenoid tubercle
d: Prominence above the glenoid; the long head of biceps arises here.

name: Supraspinous fossa
d: Fossa above the spine; supraspinatus arises here.

name: Suprastyloid crest
d: Ridge above the styloid process.

name: Supreme nuchal line
d: Highest nuchal line; the galea aponeurotica attaches to it.

name: Surgical neck of humerus
d: Constriction below the tubercles; it fractures often and the axillary nerve can be injured.

name: Sustentaculum tali
d: Shelf projecting from the medial surface of the calcaneus; supports the head of the talus, with the FHL tendon passing beneath it.

name: Symphysial surface of pubis
d: Midline articular surface of the pubis; forms the pubic symphysis with the opposite side.

name: Talar sulcus
d: Groove on the lower surface of the talus; with the calcaneal sulcus it forms the sinus tarsi.

name: Tarsal sinus
d: Laterally open canal between the talus and calcaneus; contains the interosseous talocalcaneal ligament.

name: Tegmen tympani
d: Thin bone forming the roof of the middle ear; middle ear infections can spread through it into the skull.

name: Temporal line
d: Line on the outer surface of the frontal bone to which the temporal fascia attaches.

name: Temporal surface of frontal bone
d: Surface forming the front wall of the temporal fossa; temporalis arises here.

name: Temporal surface of greater wing
d: Surface facing the temporal fossa; temporalis arises here.

name: Tibial plateau
d: Flat upper surface of the tibia; plateau fractures involve the knee joint.

name: Tibial tuberosity
d: Prominence on the front of the tibia; the patellar ligament inserts here, and Osgood–Schlatter disease occurs here.

name: Transverse costal facet
d: Facet of the transverse process that articulates with the tubercle of the rib.

name: Transverse ligament tubercle
tr: Tubercle for transverse ligament of atlas
d: Prominence on the inner surface of the lateral mass; the transverse ligament of the atlas, which holds the dens, attaches here.

name: Transverse ridges
d: Transverse lines on the pelvic surface; they mark the boundaries of the fused vertebral bodies.

name: Trapezoid line
d: Line on the lower surface of the lateral end; the trapezoid part of the coracoclavicular ligament attaches to it.

name: Trochanteric fossa
d: Fossa on the medial surface of the greater trochanter; obturator externus inserts here.

name: Trochlea of humerus
d: Pulley-shaped articular surface at the lower medial end of the humerus; forms the hinge joint with the ulna.

name: Trochlea of phalanx of foot
d: Pulley-shaped distal head of a toe phalanx; forms a hinge joint with the next phalanx.
part: Proximal phalanx of third finger of foot

name: Trochlea of phalanx of hand
d: Pulley-shaped head of a finger phalanx; forms the interphalangeal hinge joint.
part: Proximal phalanx of third finger of hand

name: Trochlea of talus
d: Pulley that sits in the mortise between the tibia and fibula; being wider in front, the joint is stable in dorsiflexion.

name: Trochlear fovea
d: Pit at the superomedial corner of the orbit; the trochlea of superior oblique attaches here.

name: Trochlear notch
d: Large notch that grips the trochlea of the humerus.

name: Tubercle of iliotibial tract
d: Prominence on the lateral condyle (Gerdy's tubercle); the iliotibial band inserts here.

name: Tubercle of rib
d: Prominence behind the junction of the neck and shaft; articulates with the transverse process.

name: Tubercle of scaphoid bone
d: Prominence on the palmar side of the scaphoid; the flexor retinaculum attaches to it, and it is felt at the front of the wrist.

name: Tubercle of trapezium bone
d: Prominence on the palmar side of the trapezium; the FCR tendon passes in the groove beside it.

name: Tuberculum sellae
d: Elevation in front of the hypophysial fossa.

name: Tuberosity for coracoclavicular ligament
d: Lower lateral surface of the clavicle; both parts of the coracoclavicular ligament attach here.

name: Tuberosity of cuboid bone
d: Ridge on the plantar surface of the cuboid; the fibularis longus tendon passes in the groove in front of it.

name: Tuberosity of distal phalanx of foot
tr: Tuberosity of distal phalanx of foot
d: Rough expansion at the tip of a distal toe phalanx; supports the soft tissue of the toe tip.
part: Distal phalanx of third finger of foot

name: Tuberosity of distal phalanx of hand
tr: Tuberosity of distal phalanx of hand
d: Expansion at the tip of a distal finger phalanx; supports the finger pulp and nail bed.
part: Distal phalanx of third finger of hand

name: Tuberosity of navicular bone
d: Projection on the medial surface of the navicular; the main insertion of tibialis posterior.

name: Tuberosity of ulna
d: Rough area below the coronoid process; brachialis inserts here.

name: Tympanic part of temporal bone
d: Part forming the bony wall of the external acoustic meatus.

name: Ulnar notch
d: Notch at the lower end of the radius; forms the distal radio-ulnar joint with the ulnar head.

name: Ulnar styloid process
d: Process at the posteromedial end of the ulnar head; the articular disc attaches to it.

name: Uncinate process of vertebra
d: Process on the upper lateral edge of a cervical vertebral body; it forms the uncovertebral (Luschka) joint, and osteophytes here can compress nerve roots.

name: Vaginal process of sphenoid bone
d: Thin process on the lower surface of the body; articulates with the vomer.

name: Vestibular surface of tooth
d: Surface of a tooth facing the cheek or lip.

name: Zygomatic margin of greater wing
d: Margin that articulates with the zygomatic bone.

name: Zygomatic process of frontal bone
d: Lateral process that articulates with the zygomatic bone; it forms the upper lateral margin of the orbit.
